cases.claim: A timer returned by AfterFunc has a nil C field.
Stop on an already running AfterFunc callback waits for that callback to finish.
Reset after the AfterFunc callback has started returns false and schedules another execution.
A callback scheduled by Reset cannot overlap the previous callback.
Stop before a far-future AfterFunc expires can return true and prevent that scheduled execution.
Reassigning only the caller function variable after AfterFunc registration changes which function that timer will invoke.
The application must retry a timed-out operation exactly three times.
